profile.headline: Engineering Leader | Product Engineering, ML and AI
profile.summary: As Co-Founder of Makai Digital, I’m building a company that delivers innovative, AI-powered solutions to help enterprises grow and transform. I lead with an entrepreneurial vision—driving strategy, assembling high-performing teams, and partnering closely with clients to create technology that delivers real impact. Passionate about solving complex challenges through collaboration and quality, I’m focused on growing Makai into a lasting force for meaningful change.

positions.title: Founder & Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearhead the strategic direction and growth of Makai Digital, focusing on innovative AI-powered solutions.  
• Build and lead high-performing technical teams to tackle complex challenges for enterprise clients.  
• Foster partnerships with clients to deliver scalable solutions tailored to their unique needs.

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated the enterprise administration applications from a Python monolith to a React SPA backed by a GraphQL backend-for-frontend
Lead the architecture and implementation of a CMS-backed web application, deployable to any domain, localized content managed through a headless CMS and SEO optimizations
Served as a Tech lead for the Enterprise Tools team, coaching other engineers and ensuring architectural best practices are followed
Built CICD pipelines for new services using Terraform and Gradle
Contributed to the React Universal Component Library used by web and mobile applications

Technologies: Typescript, React, Node.js, GraphQL, Terraform, Gradle, Contenful

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Architect/Lead/Developer and Responsible for end to end product development. Deeply involved with design and implementation of current and future products. Delivering software solutions and service by using and implementing various process models.
Define all processes used by team – change management, review, unit test, coding standard, etc.
Enforced quality standards through code and design reviews.
Performed risk analysis and developed mitigation strategies.
Delegate work to team members.
Lead the development of responsive pages and shared global components
Lead the implementation of a business critical project aimed to increase revenue by increasing conversions in our eCommerce platform
Lead an enterprise project aimed to integrate of US and Australia portfolios, working in coordination with Mainframe, SQL DBAs, Data-warehouse and other teams across the enterprise

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Develop of new features for the Cruise Search API and Core customer facing applications.

Technologies:  ASP.NET 4.5, .NET Core, Typescript, Angular, React, AWS, ElasticSearch, CloudSearch, REST APIs, SQL, Node.js, Webpack, Sass, Sitecore

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.description:
o	Designed and developed robust and scalable web and mobile applications according to client specifications and business rules.
o	Provided consulting services to Fortune 500 companies such as: ADT, Regions Bank, Citibank, Carnival Cruise Lines, and Universal
o	Collaborated with UX designers and clients’ development teams and provided technical leadership and guidance to deliver high performing applications

Technologies: J2EE, ASP.NET MVC 4, JavaScript, Node.js, Angular, REST APIs, Express, Passport, MySQL, MongoDB, Gulp, Jade, Sass

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
o	Supported the development and testing of internal web-based tools that supported operations for the actuary department and the quoting engine.
o	Ensured software quality by creating automated unit and integration test suites
o	Collaborated with business partners to capture requirements and understand business logic to develop high quality applications that enabled positive business outcomes.
o	Lead the design, development and testing of an internal web application to be used by developers and UX designers to quickly mockup functional applications

Technologies: Spring MVC, SFX Framework, J2EE, JavaScript, Android SDK, MySQL, IBM DB2, Maven, SOAP
